author: Ari Koslow
title: Jac Caglianone scratched with left groin soreness
desc: Jac Caglianone was scratched from the Royals lineup on Sunday with left groin soreness.
impact: Caglianone will continue to be further evaluated heading into Monday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Altuve (leg) not in lineup Sunday
desc: Jose Altuve is not in the Astros starting lineup for Sunday's series finale against the Tigers.
impact: Altuve was removed from Saturday's game late. Astros manager Joe Espada said he would be fine, but he'll still sit on Sunday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Wicks recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs recalled LHP Jordan Wicks from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Wicks will add some length in the bullpen heading into Sunday's series finale against the Brewers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vince Velasquez designated for assignment
desc: The Cubs designated RHP Vince Velasquez for assignment.
impact: Velasquez has thrown 3 1/3 scoreless innings with the Cubs. He will return to waivers where he could draw some interest.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Fraley (hernia) sent on rehab assignment Saturday
desc: Jake Fraley began a rehab assignment in the Florida Complex League on Saturday.
impact: Fraley has been sidelined since May 16 after undergoing surgery to repair a hernia. He should be activated in early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Allen (hamstring) sent on rehab assignment Saturday
desc: Nick Allen began a rehab assignment at Triple-A Sugar Land on Saturday.
impact: Allen has been sidelined since early June due to a left hamstring strain. He should be activated in early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Short sent outright by Mets
desc: The Mets sent INF Zack Short outright to Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Short was designated for assignment earlier in the week. He will remain in the Mets organization for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Soderstrom suffers hip injury Saturday
desc: Tyler Soderstrom was removed from Saturday's game against the Angels due to hip tightness.
impact: Soderstrom is being further evaluated on Sunday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam Huff designated for assignment
desc: The Orioles designated C Sam Huff for assignment.
impact: Huff will head to waivers with Adley Rutschman activated from the concussion injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adley Rutschman activated from concussion IL
desc: The Orioles activated C Adley Rutschman from the 7-day concussion injured list.
impact: Rutschman has been sidelined for the past week. He was able to clear all protocols in time to return for Sunday's series finale against the Nationals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dylan Beavers (oblique) activated from IL
desc: The Orioles activated OF Dylan Beavers from the 10-day injured list.
impact: Beavers had been sidelined since mid-May due to an oblique strain. Jeremiah Jackson was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremiah Jackson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles optioned INF Jeremiah Jackson to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Jackson will return to Triple-A with Dylan Beavers activated from the injured list. He could get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Dunn (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Reds placed OF Blake Dunn on the 10-day injured list with a right elbow sprain.
impact: Dunn suffered the injury to his elbow over the weekend. He does not hold a clear timetable to return. TJ Friedl was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: TJ Friedl recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Reds recalled OF TJ Friedl from Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Friedl was able to find some confidence back in Triple-A after a slow start to the season in the majors. He'll look to carry that confidence into another stint in the majors. Blake Dunn (elbow) was placed on the injured list as the corresponding move.
